title: a-commit-reseals-only-the-seals-whose-closure-it-changes
intention: A commit reseals only the seals whose recorded closure contains a file the commit changes — the changed proof itself, plus the owning component's proofs whose fingerprint_closure names a staged file — so adding one proof reseals one seal, never the whole component serially.
why: RULE 1 in Akien's words: "we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files." On 2026-10-05 a commit adding one proof to cairn/devices/tester ran past a 30-minute limit inside the pre-commit reseal: proofs_touching selects all 33 of the owning component's proofs and reseals them serially; one, test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py, took 793s alone (a measurement, its own smell). The lived symptom is a builder's one-file commit that cannot land in half an hour, re-deriving verdicts whose closures never moved (Law 1).
traces_to: RULE 1 (Akien, 2026-10-01: 'we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files'); Law 1 (re-running a proof whose closure did not move re-derives a settled verdict); foreground-decisions item 7 ('tool proofs: agreed' — the reseal door re-runs only the changed component's proofs, 'via fingerprint_closure')
how: In cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py proofs_touching(): keep the owner filter (Akien's 'tool proofs: agreed', foreground-decisions item 7) and narrow within it — a proof of an owning component is selected when it is itself staged, or its standing seal's fingerprint_closure (closure_of) contains a staged path, or it has no seal, or its seal predates closures (closure_of is None: the whole-component recipe answers, conservative). Everything else in the owning component is left alone; component_color still reds any seal whose fingerprint moved. Proof under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/, written red.
falsifier: GREEN when a proof under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/ builds a fixture component with three sealed proofs whose closures are disjoint, stages one NEW proof file, and proofs_touching returns exactly that one proof; staging a file named in one sealed proof's closure returns exactly that proof plus none of the others; a proof with no seal and a pre-closure seal are each selected. WRONG INTENT if the recorded closures are too coarse to separate proofs (every tester seal naming every tester file), which a census of the 33 tester seals' fingerprint_closure measures first. Measured beside it: the 793s proof is test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py.
watchme: none, because the consumer is the next commit that touches cairn/devices/tester: the pre-commit hook cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit prints which proofs it resealed, and that count is the measurement this ticket bounds
children: none, because the change is one selection function in one device with one proof
